summary: The flat2d explainer reel maintains a consistent visual style and clear character proportions throughout the plaza and board scenes. Minor improvements are needed in text placement and avoiding redundant background repetition.

clean: shot 0: character correctly passing the mate
shot 2: character sitting on a bench holding a phone
shot 5: character offering the mate naturally
shot 9: character contemplating with proper hand positioning
unclean: shot 3: identical bench layout repeats directly next to the characters without spatial variation

clean: consistent flat 2D character designs and color palette
good scaling of props like the thermos and mate gourd
unclean: shot 6: text overlays partially overlap with the character's hair area

issues.problem: Headlines and text elements sit too close to the upper character bounds.
issues.fix: Keep text boxes strictly within the designated top caption area.

learnings.rule: Do not repeat identical background asset clusters side by side without varying scale or spacing.
